name: Venomtail Poison Sac
summary: In Durotar, a scorpion's venom can bring a hunter near death, and its poison sac holds what alchemists need for a cure.

sections.title: A Deadly Toxin and Its Remedy
sections.body:
Scorpids roam Durotar’s red rocks. Venomtail Scorpids, Corrupted Scorpids, and the Death Flayer all carry sacs filled with fast-acting venom. Left untreated, the poison can overwhelm even seasoned warriors. Yet those same sacs hold the chief compounds alchemists need for an antidote.

When a scorpion stung the hunter Rhinag outside Orgrimmar, local alchemists needed four fresh poison sacs. They would use them to make a remedy and neutralize the venom in his veins.

faq.q: What creatures carry these poison sacs?
aliases: where to get venomtail poison sac
faq.answer: Durotar’s scorpids carry these poison sacs, especially Venomtail Scorpids near Orgrimmar. Corrupted Scorpids and the rare Death Flayer carry them too.

faq.q: What is the poison sac used for?
aliases: why do i need venomtail poison sac
faq.answer: Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar uses the sacs to distill a specialized antidote. Rhinag needs it after being stung and poisoned while hunting without proper preparation.

faq.q: Who can brew the antidote from these sacs?
aliases: where to turn in venomtail sacs
faq.answer: Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar can refine the raw venom from four intact sacs into a curative draft. He must do so before the poison proves fatal.

angles.text: As a young Horde adventurer in Durotar, you learn that local toxins can kill those who rush into the red wastes unprepared.
As a hunter, take Rhinag’s misfortune as a warning. Pursuing dangerous beasts without knowing their venom or carrying a remedy can cost you your life.
